text:
Sophie L: Hey team, quick sync — partner wants a small starter kit combining our Terraform modules + a sample app they can deploy in their marketplace listing. Target: internal pilot in 3 weeks.
Rahul P: Got it. Do we have a canonical repo for sample app + modules?
Micaela G: There's an internal repo but it's mostly demo-only. We should make a production-ish reference pattern.
John K: Agree. Minimal checklist: 1) module inputs/outputs documented, 2) example pipeline, 3) cloud marketplace packaging notes, 4) license/attribution file.
Sophie L: Also need Graviton/Ampere notes and an easy toggle for instance types. Partner specifically called out both arm64 and x86.
Rahul P: I'll prep two tfvars and a tiny wrapper script. Could add a test in ci that runs terraform plan --target=module.redwood_infra to catch drift.
Micaela G: Can we include an opinionated batching config example for the inference service? That helps customers tune cost/latency.
John K: Yes — include recommended env vars and a short snippet in the README. Eg:
```
# example batching config
service:
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  max_batch_requests: 32
  prefer_low_latency: true
```
Rahul P: For packaging, partner needs a single archive. I'll add a top-level starterkit/ folder with modules/, samples/, charts/, and a marketplace/manifest.yaml.
Sophie L: Heads-up: legal asked for a short third-party dependency callout. Add LICENSE + NOTICE and a short section in README about model licensing.
partners-bot: Created ticket PARTNERS-8842: "Starter kit: partner marketplace deliverable" assigned to @Rahul P — https://issues.redwood/8842 :ticket:
Micaela G: Who owns the runbook for upgrades? Partner region will want playbook for upgrades/rollbacks.
John K: Ops runbook lives in eng-platform/playbooks. I'll copy a trimmed version to starterkit/playbooks/ops.md and mark sensitive sections for Private deployments.
Sophie L: Timeline check — Rahul: module polish (3 days), sample app + docs (4 days), package + QA (3 days). That fits 2-week buffer for pilot.
Rahul P: On it. I'll push a branch like feat/partner-starterkit and ping when ready.
Micaela G: I'll draft the partner-facing README and a short workshop slide deck (15 min).
John K: Ping me for a quick security review before packaging. I want to validate KMS hints and removal of debug creds.
Sophie L: Great. @Rahul P can you paste the minimal snippet we'll show in the workshop for a terraform module call?
Rahul P: Sure — paste below:
```
module "redwood_infra" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/infrastructure/modules/inference"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = var.instance_type # e.g. g5.12xlarge or m6g.8xlarge
  replicas = 2
}
```
Micaela G: Perfect. Add a note: "use instance_type toggle for arm64/x86 and refer to compatibility.md".
partners-bot: PARTNERS-8842 status changed to In Progress by Rahul P
Sophie L: Cool — I'll update the partner plan and schedule the workshop. Thanks all :thumbsup:
